identity.how: the judged values of each run on G-C2.2's fresh members, computed again from the state files, must equal G-C2.2's within the tolerance

label_free.trained_in: G-C2.2; the state files are read, nothing is trained

supervised_512.how: G-C2.2's run with the supervised loss of G-C2.1 in place of the energy: the same network, training members, steps, optimiser, schedule, clipping and stability recipe, and a fresh random order of the members every epoch; each step takes 4 of the labelled levels of its member

base.unchanged: family, training members, loading, evaluation levels, network, label-free loss, sampling, learning rate, schedule, budget, stability recipe, judged quantity, the raw and the condensed reading

comparison.ratios: supervised over label-free, for each of the two statistics
comparison.statistics: for each arm, the median over its three seeds of the median, and of the 90th percentile, over the 448 pairs of |F / F*(e) - 1|

criteria.R: part 1, the ranking: in each run that has a pair above 0.05 and a pair at or below 0.05, the probability that a pair above 0.05 has a larger spread than a pair at or below 0.05 (ties count half) is at least 0.90; HOLDS iff so in every such run, NOT EVALUABLE if there is no such run
criteria.S1: part 1: no pair that is not flagged has |F / F*(e) - 1| above 0.10 in any of the three runs
criteria.S2: part 1: of the (pair, run) readings of the pairs that are not flagged, at most 0.01 have |F / F*(e) - 1| above 0.05
criteria.S3: part 1: at most 0.35 of the 448 pairs are flagged
criteria.comparison: part 2: 'comparable' iff both ratios lie in the band; 'supervised closer' iff both ratios are below 1 and at least one is below the band; 'label-free closer' iff both are above 1 and at least one is above the band; 'mixed' otherwise
criteria.final: an outcome that is INVALID, and a part that is INCOMPLETE by a stop condition, are final: the gate is not run again on this sample
criteria.identity: if a label-free run does not reproduce G-C2.2's judged values on G-C2.2's fresh members within the tolerance, neither part is evaluated: the verdict is INVALID. The same holds when a value cannot be computed: a label-free run without finite predictions, or a member of G-C2.2's fresh sample without metrics in a label-free run. An end without finite predictions is final: the run is not predicted again
criteria.incomplete: part 1 is INCOMPLETE while the label-free arm has not been evaluated or one of its runs has neither predictions nor a non-finite end; part 2 is INCOMPLETE while an arm has not been evaluated or one of its runs has neither predictions nor a non-finite stop
criteria.infinite_pairs: a pair whose reference solve at the predicted end displacement fails, or gives a force that is not positive, has an infinite error, which counts as above every threshold
criteria.member_without_metrics: a member of the judged set whose metrics the reference code cannot compute: in a label-free run, part 1 is FAIL and R is NOT EVALUABLE; in a run of either arm, the seed enters the medians over seeds of part 2 with infinite errors
criteria.non_finite_seed: a supervised seed whose run stopped on a non-finite loss or on non-finite predictions enters the medians over seeds with infinite errors
criteria.not_resumed: a command that is stopped and not run again leaves INCOMPLETE what needs it: both parts for the evaluation of the label-free arm, part 2 for a supervised run or the evaluation of the supervised arm
criteria.reported_not_judged: both readings of both arms on every set, with the values C1 and C2 of G-C2.2 would take; the median error of both arms at each level; the ratios of the supervised arm read raw over the label-free arm in the judged reading; the pairs above 0.05 and 0.10 and how many of them are flagged; the spread and the flags on the other sets and in the raw reading; the spread of the supervised runs; the time and the reference solutions each arm needed; the cap's actions
criteria.self_check: PASS iff S1, S2 and S3
criteria.training_label_failure: if a label of a training member does not converge or fails its checks, the supervised arm is not trained and part 2 stays INCOMPLETE; part 1 stands. No other solver settings are tried

label_solver.order: levels in increasing order, each from the previous level's solution

data.training_members: seed 20261106, the 512 training members of G-C2.1 (the seed is reused on purpose)

evaluation.contact_tolerance: u_x <= 1e-3 (D + delta) on the plane between the flanges, for prediction and reference alike
evaluation.force: the point (e, F) of a field, F = 4 k_s (D - e) its spring reading; judged by its distance from the reference curve in force at the predicted end displacement, F / F*(e) - 1, F*(e) from an exact solve under displacement control
metrics: F_pred / F_ref - 1 at the same D
the stress reading F_sigma = 4 grad W . v over F_ref, minus 1
certified bound 4 sqrt(2 k_s (Pi - Pi*)) / F_ref
plastic Gauss points intersection over union
evaluation.precision: float64, the reference code (fejoint.nlhex, fejoint.nlsolve) on the exported problem

condensed.amplitude: a minimises the training energy (float32, c2.torch_energy) of z_c at the level's D over a_min <= a <= a_max: a safeguarded secant iteration on dPi/da from a = 1, at most max_evaluations energy evaluations, stopped at |dPi/da| <= rtol Pi; the evaluated point of lowest energy is returned
condensed.field: z_c = keep(z_0 + a (z - z_0)): z the network's field at the level's D, z_0 its field at base_level_mm, keep the contact unknowns set to at least zero
condensed.labels: none: no reference solution enters a reading

readings.raw: the point (e, F) of the network's field z at the level's D, as in G-C2.1

family.fixed: rolled T-stub pair, quarter model; L 80 mm, one bolt row at y = 20 mm, web to H = 120 mm; M12 bolts, two washers, bearing radius 12 mm; E 210000, nu 0.3

loading.how: the web's end section rigid in x (one unknown e), joined by a linear spring to the loading device, whose displacement D is prescribed; the force on the pair F = 4 k_s (D - e)

family.steel: elastic to fy, plateau to 2% strain, linear to 1.35 fy at 15%, then E/10000; a slope of E/10000 added throughout the plastic range
family.theory: J2 deformation theory (Hencky), small strain; frictionless unilateral contact

map.on: u_x of the plane between the flanges and the separation slots of the bearing patch

model.decoder: a copy of the repository's FieldDecoder (node latent and pooled latent, two GELU layers), last layer zeroed at the start
model.features: centred RMS-normalised coordinates (3), Dirichlet flags (3), node flags (7), family parameters over their range maxima (7), loading-device displacement over D_max (1)
model.head: the end section's u_x (e) and the bolt head's three unknowns from the pooled latent (two GELU layers), last layer zeroed
model.output_scale: D + delta (mm): every nodal output, e and the head's axial unknown times it, the head's two tilts times it over the bearing radius

self_check.flag: a pair is flagged when its spread is at least the threshold
self_check.force: F = 4 k_s (D - e), the spring reading of a run's field at the level's D; no reference solution
self_check.spread: for each (member, level) pair, (max - min) / |median| of F over the three runs; a pair whose median F is zero is flagged
self_check.threshold_from: the upper quartile of the spread over the 448 pairs of G-C2.1's held-out members (0.004504), rounded; found in an exploratory reading of G-C2.2's records

training.D_sampling: sqrt(D) uniform between sqrt(0.1) and sqrt(D_max) (label-free); 4 of the labelled levels without replacement (supervised)
training.batch: one instance per step with 4 end displacements; instances in a fresh random order each epoch

encoder_gradient_cap.how: before the global clipping, the encoder's gradient is scaled down to at most factor times the median of its norm over the previous window_steps steps (norms before any scaling), from step window_steps + 1 on; a step whose ratio exceeds burst_factor is recorded as a burst

training.energy_loss: mean over the step's fields of log Pi (Pi > 0 for D > 0)
training.non_finite: a non-finite loss stops the run; the stop is final and is not retried
training.precision: float32 weights, activations and energy; float32 matmul precision 'highest' (no TF32)
training.schedule: cosine with linear warm-up over the first 5% of steps (the repository's)
training.supervised_loss: mean squared error of the physical displacement over (D + delta)^2
